title: Japan Issues Tsunami Advisory After Strong Earthquake Off Its Coast
summary: A tsunami was expected to come ashore with a maximum height of about three feet after a 6.7-magnitude quake struck off Japan’s coast early Sunday evening.

title: Special voting for forces and displaced in Iraq parliamentary polls begins
summary: Nearly 1.3 million members of the security forces and more than 26,500 internally displaced people are eligible to vote.

title: Super Typhoon Fung-wong approaches Philippines, nearly 1 million evacuated
summary: Philippines weather bureau warns of 'life-threatening conditions' as super storm heads for its largest island.
